entries.title: Psalms 57:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.>> Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until [these] calamities be overpast. {Altaschith: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

words.text: in thee: yea, in the shadow
. {Altaschith: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

entries.title: Psalms 57:2
segments: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth [all things] for me.

entries.title: Psalms 57:3
segments: He shall send from heaven, and save me [from] the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth. {from the...: or, he reproacheth him that}

words.text: of him that would swallow me up
. {from the...: or, he reproacheth him that}

entries.title: Psalms 57:4
segments: My soul [is] among lions: [and] I lie [even among] them that are set on fire, [even] the sons of men, whose teeth [are] spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

words.text: [even among] them that are set on fire

entries.title: Psalms 57:5
segments: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 57:6
segments: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen [themselves]. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 57:7
segments: ¶My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise. {fixed: or, prepared}

entries.title: Psalms 57:8
segments: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I [myself] will awake early.

entries.title: Psalms 57:9
segments: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 57:10
segments: For thy mercy [is] great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 57:11
segments: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: [let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
